metadata.method: GitHub API search + manual curation, ≥20 repos, quality-filtered; builds on m8667/m9356 baseline with acceptance criteria added to GAP anchors

tier_legend.1: 方法专家仓 (core BEM methodology: acoustics/EM/potential flow solvers with Green functions, H-matrix, FMM acceleration)
tier_legend.2: 可微/框架族 (differentiable, modern framework, cross-platform, JIT-compiled)
tier_legend.3: 专项能力 (specialized capability: education, geomechanics, niche physics, converters)

metadata.negative_ledger_check: no prior TensorBEM negative entries found
metadata.prior_art_check: builds on m8667 oss-bem-disc registry (30 repos, 8 gaps); adds acceptance criteria per GAP

repositories.summary: Python BEM solver for linear potential flow based on Nemoh; computes hydrodynamic coefficients (added mass, radiation damping, diffraction forces) for marine structures; active development with conda distribution.
Just-in-time compiled BEM library for Python; supports Laplace/Helmholtz/Maxwell; CPU/GPU backends; modern architecture with Numba JIT; active development.
Computational electromagnetics using BEM; Casimir/fluctuation-induced phenomena; GPU acceleration; research-grade; stale but scientifically rigorous.
Fast multipole method for electromagnetic scattering; MLFMA acceleration; research-grade; demonstrates industrial-scale BEM-FMM coupling.
Hydrodynamic BEM post-processor and converter; supports AQWA/WAMIT/MOSES/Sesam formats; visualization; not a solver but essential tooling.
Julia package for boundary integral equations; differentiable; electromagnetic scattering; modern language; active development.
Blade Element Momentum Theory (BEMT) for marine propellers; note: BEMT ≠ BEM (boundary element method); specialized application.
Template-based FMM library; supports Laplace/Helmholtz/Stokes kernels; high-performance; research-grade; foundational for BEM acceleration.
Parallel FEM-BEM coupling framework; MPI-based; supports domain decomposition; modern C++; active maintenance.
MATLAB toolbox for FEM/BEM; fast solvers; acoustics/vibration; educational; no explicit license.
Black-box FMM in Python; kernel-agnostic; easy to use; good for prototyping; wraps low-level FMM.
BEM for fault mechanics and dislocations; geophysics/seismology; MATLAB-based; specialized application.
Scaled Boundary FEM (SBFEM) as ABAQUS user element; fracture mechanics; specialized; research-grade.
Classic FMM library for 3D Laplace/Helmholtz; Fortran; high-performance; foundational; widely cited.
2D BEM solver in Python; educational focus; Laplace equation; good for learning; no explicit license.
Surface-only BEM for deformable objects; computer graphics; real-time simulation; specialized application.
Boundary element methods in Rust; performance and safety focus; modern language; emerging ecosystem; potential for high-performance BEM applications.
2D potential flow with vortex particles; BEM-based; aerodynamics; research-grade; active development.
BEM for metallic nanoparticles; plasmonics; MATLAB; specialized electromagnetic application; well-documented.
Mesh infrastructure for BEM in Julia; triangulation; foundational for BEAST.jl; active development.
BEM for acoustics; Jupyter-based; educational focus; implements acoustic BEM solver; includes tutorials.
Fast, flexible, multi-kernel, multi-system FMM implementation in Julia; modern language; supports various kernel types; active development.
Simple package for solving boundary integral equations using collocation BEM in Julia; educational focus; clean implementation; good for learning BIE methods.
Triangulation, BEM, FMM code for Python; NIST ion storage application; educational value; demonstrates BEM-FMM coupling.
Task-based FMM parallelized with OpenMP and StarPU; supports multiple GPUs via CUDA; high-performance; research-grade implementation.
BEM for acoustics; Jupyter-based; educational focus; implements acoustic BEM solver; includes tutorials and examples.
Fast approximations for boundary element based brittle fracture simulation; reduced basis methods; research-grade; focuses on computational efficiency.
Lightweight BEM library for hydrodynamics and aerodynamics; C++ implementation; focuses on simplicity and ease of use; suitable for engineering applications.
3D free-surface Green function for marine hydrodynamics; Fortran; finite/infinite depth; foundational for wave BEM.
Coupled boundary layer theory / potential theory BEM solver for incompressible flow around airfoils; MATLAB-based; educational and research tool.

GAP-BEM-1.title: 可微分BEM求解器
GAP-BEM-1.problem: 现有开源BEM库（除BEAST.jl外）缺乏原生自动微分支持，无法直接嵌入梯度优化/反问题/UQ流程
GAP-BEM-1.opportunity: 基于JAX/PyTorch构建可微BEM内核，支持Green函数/积分算子的自动微分，服务于形状优化/参数反演
GAP-BEM-1.acceptance_criteria: 实现Laplace/Helmholtz核的JAX可微BEM算子；对单位圆/球解析解梯度误差<1e-6；支持至少2个下游优化案例（形状优化+参数反演）

GAP-BEM-2.title: H-matrix/FMM加速的工业级BEM
GAP-BEM-2.problem: 开源BEM多为教学/研究级，缺乏生产级H-matrix/FMM加速（Puma-EM仅限电磁学）
GAP-BEM-2.opportunity: 构建通用H-matrix库（支持Laplace/Helmholtz/Stokes核），与现有BEM求解器解耦，提供Python/C++接口
GAP-BEM-2.acceptance_criteria: 实现O(N log N)复杂度的FMM加速；对10^5自由度问题，相比密集BEM加速>50倍；精度损失<1%；支持至少3种核函数

GAP-BEM-3.title: 船舶水动力BEM基准验证面
GAP-BEM-3.problem: Capytaine基于Nemoh但缺乏系统性验证面（解析解/实验数据对标），精度声明不充分
GAP-BEM-3.opportunity: 建立船舶水动力BEM基准库：Wigley船型/ Series 60等解析解+实验数据，自动化回归测试，精度<3%判据
GAP-BEM-3.acceptance_criteria: 建立≥5个解析解基准（圆柱/球/Wigley等）+≥3个实验数据对标；自动化pytest验证面；关键量（附加质量/阻尼/波激励力）误差<3%

GAP-BEM-4.title: GPU加速BEM内核
GAP-BEM-4.problem: 现有开源BEM几乎无GPU实现（bempp-rs有潜力但未成熟），大规模问题性能受限
GAP-BEM-4.opportunity: 基于CUDA/HIP实现BEM核心积分/Green函数计算，支持Helmholtz/Laplace/Stokes核，与FMM耦合
GAP-BEM-4.acceptance_criteria: 实现CUDA版BEM积分核；对10^5面板问题，相比CPU加速>10倍；数值精度与CPU版一致（相对误差<1e-10）；支持至少2种Green函数

GAP-BEM-5.title: 多物理场BEM耦合框架
GAP-BEM-5.problem: 声学/电磁/势流BEM各自独立，缺乏统一框架支持FEM-BEM耦合/多物理场
GAP-BEM-5.opportunity: 构建模块化BEM框架：统一网格/算子/求解器接口，支持声学-结构/电磁-热/势流-弹性耦合
GAP-BEM-5.acceptance_criteria: 实现统一BEM框架，支持≥3种物理场（声学/电磁/势流）；提供FEM-BEM耦合接口；至少1个多物理场耦合验证案例（如声学-结构FSI）

GAP-BEM-6.title: 自由面Green函数高效计算
GAP-BEM-6.problem: FinGreen3D等实现老旧，缺乏现代优化（向量化/GPU），计算效率低
GAP-BEM-6.opportunity: 重写自由面Green函数库：现代Fortran/C++/Python接口，支持有限/无限水深，向量化+GPU加速
GAP-BEM-6.acceptance_criteria: 实现现代自由面Green函数库；支持有限/无限水深；向量化版本相比FinGreen3D加速>5倍；数值精度与解析解误差<1e-8；提供Python/C++接口

GAP-BEM-7.title: BEM网格质量与自适应
GAP-BEM-7.problem: 开源BEM缺乏自适应网格细化/误差估计，用户需手动调网格
GAP-BEM-7.opportunity: 实现基于后验误差估计的自适应BEM：支持h/p自适应，与求解器解耦，提供Python接口
GAP-BEM-7.acceptance_criteria: 实现后验误差估计器；支持h-自适应细化；对奇异问题（裂纹/角点），自适应网格相比均匀网格效率提升>3倍（达到相同精度所需自由度更少）

GAP-BEM-8.title: BEM与机器学习集成
GAP-BEM-8.problem: BEM求解器与ML框架（PyTorch/JAX）集成困难，无法利用神经网络加速/代理模型
GAP-BEM-8.opportunity: 构建BEM-ML桥接层：BEM算子导出为PyTorch模块，支持神经网络代理模型/物理信息神经网络(PINN)混合求解
GAP-BEM-8.acceptance_criteria: 实现BEM算子的PyTorch模块封装；训练神经网络代理模型，对参数化问题预测误差<5%；推理速度相比直接BEM求解加速>100倍
